first_step_test: One connected left-facing head and curved torso outline establishes the seahorse pose and leaves a clear lower route for the spiral tail.

source.notes: Six-panel cumulative handmade black felt-tip contact sheet on white paper. Keep one left-facing seahorse with fixed snout, spiral tail, dorsal fin, three crest bumps, one eye, belly bands, and exactly three bubbles.

final_elements.name: head snout and curved torso
final_elements.description: One left-facing seahorse profile with long tubular snout, rounded forehead and curved upright torso open at the tail base.

final_elements.name: spiral tail and dorsal fin
final_elements.description: One thick tail curling inward below the belly and one scalloped fin with three interior ribs attached behind the upper back.

final_elements.name: three crest bumps and one eye
final_elements.description: Exactly three small crest bumps along the top of the head and one round eye with a dark pupil.

final_elements.name: belly boundary three dividers and pectoral fin
final_elements.description: One curved inner belly boundary from under the jaw toward the tail base, three cross-belly dividers making four bands, and one small fan-shaped pectoral fin attached behind the neck.

final_elements.name: three bubbles and small cheek spots
final_elements.description: Exactly three simple round bubbles rising to the left of the snout and two small cheek spots.

frames.visible_job: Connect one snout, rounded head, and curving torso in their final positions.
frames.instruction: Start with a short tube snout pointing left, curve up over the forehead and back of the head, then sweep down through a rounded torso. Return along the belly, leaving its lower end open for the curled tail.

frames.visible_job: Connect one inward spiral tail and a scalloped dorsal fin with three ribs.
frames.instruction: From the open lower body, draw a broad tail that curls once inward to a rounded tip. Attach one scalloped fin to the upper back and give it three short ribs, keeping the torso edge clear.

frames.step_name: Give it a face and crest
frames.visible_job: Add one round eye and exactly three bumps along the existing crown.
frames.instruction: Place one round eye above the snout with a small dark pupil. Build exactly three short crest bumps along the crown, rooted in the head rather than floating above it.
adds: three crest bumps and one eye
introduces: three crest bumps and one eye

frames.visible_job: Add the curved belly boundary and three dividers, then one attached pectoral fin.
frames.instruction: From below the jaw, curve an inner belly boundary toward the tail base. Cross it with three short curved dividers to make four broad bands. Attach one small fan-shaped pectoral fin behind the neck.
introduces: belly boundary three dividers and pectoral fin

frames.visible_job: Place three bubbles by the snout and two small cheek spots; reinforce the established black contour.
frames.instruction: Draw exactly three simple bubbles rising beside the snout, then place two small spots on the cheek. Reinforce the existing outer contour with a black felt tip, keeping the inside bands lighter.
adds: three bubbles and small cheek spots
introduces: three bubbles and small cheek spots

final_step.visible_job: Fill established regions with streaky marker color and strengthen their keeper outlines.
final_step.instruction: Fill the established body coral orange, the belly bands pale yellow, the dorsal and pectoral fins teal, and the three bubbles light blue. Leave a little white paper in each region and strengthen only the existing black edges.

visual_review.first_step_observation: The first saved crop is copyable without seeing later frames: one left-facing tube snout joins a rounded head and S-curved torso, with two open lower endpoints reserved for a single curled tail. No eye, fin, crest, bands or bubbles are premature.
visual_review.draw_through_observation: I inspected the full sheet and all six saved JPGs in adjacent order. The snout tip, crown, body bends, tail spiral, dorsal-fin root, crest roots, eye, inner belly boundary, pectoral-fin attachment, three bubble positions and two cheek spots remain spatially consistent. There are no temporary guides. The last frame only colors the established shapes, retaining imperfect felt-tip outlines and visible marker streaks.

transitions.observed_addition: The second saved crop preserves the left-facing tube snout, round head, open lower torso and its exact pose; one thick tail extends from the lower opening into a single inward spiral, and a scalloped dorsal fin with three ribs attaches behind the upper back.
transitions.instruction_match: The tail connects to both lower torso ends without a moved tip, and the dorsal fin stays behind the existing back line as the instruction describes.

transitions.instruction_match: The eye sits inside the established head and the three crest bumps follow the written count; no body, fin, snout or tail route changes.
